name: com.haodanku.sdk.plate.HdkHomeActivity
description: When the app opens a Haodanku BianXian shopping page, this screen builds its tabs from page data supplied by the SDK and loads each tab inside an embedded browser. BianXian uses it as its in-app shopping and service hub.
disableEffect: BianXian's shopping and service pages will not open, while the host app's other screens remain available.
